judgments.reasoning_cat1: 'Subsidiaries of holding companies of the named insured' is loose — it is unclear whether it reaches sister companies, and it purports to extend a statutory definition by agreement.
judgments.reasoning_cat2: It expands the class caught by c100 while the Additional Named Insureds list (c085) and Named Insured definition (c020) define the corporate family differently.

judgments.reasoning_cat1: Three cumulative conditions are enumerated clearly, but the final words 'identified as being listed for contingency coverage purposes' describe a designation the drafter never made.
judgments.reasoning_cat2: Item 7 of the Declarations lists no policy identified for contingency coverage purposes, so the drop-down cannot be applied as written against the Schedule of Underlying Insurance.

judgments.reasoning_cat1: 'At its sole option may make an appropriate premium charge' leaves 'appropriate' entirely to the insurer, but the discretion is expressly unilateral.
judgments.reasoning_cat2: It mirrors the identical premium clause in the Professional Liability Limits endorsement (c122) and does not clash with the Premium condition (c044).

judgments.reasoning_cat1: It disapplies 'Form No. 035(12/87)' when the form actually attached is Form No. 035 WI (1/94) — a citation error that could be said to leave the professional services exclusion untouched.
judgments.reasoning_cat2: The Schedule of Endorsements and the exclusion itself (c082, c083) identify the form differently, so the cross-reference cannot be matched to the instrument as issued.

judgments.reasoning_cat1: The endorsement is little more than a recitation of a statute, with the operative amendment expressed only as compliance with it.
judgments.reasoning_cat2: It amends a 'Hospital Professional Liability coverage part attached to the policy' that does not exist in this umbrella form, and Endorsement No. 5 (c111) deletes this very form as null and void while it remains in the Schedule of Endorsements.

judgments.reasoning_cat1: 'Legal or other expenses necessarily incurred ... in determining which insurer shall bear the loss' is a broad and unusual promise whose boundary ('necessarily') is not fixed.
judgments.reasoning_cat2: It promises expense indemnity while the ultimate net loss definition (c033) excludes all loss and legal expenses and the Other Insurance condition (c052) governs the same overlap problem.

judgments.reasoning_cat1: The clause says coverage 'shall not apply to trebled damages' and then promises to pay 'one-third of the total sum' — a self-cancelling pair that also excludes plaintiff's legal fees twice over.
judgments.reasoning_cat2: Endorsement No. 5 (c111) deletes Form 009-133 as null and void, yet the form remains in the Schedule of Endorsements and in the policy text.

judgments.reasoning_cat1: Attachment boilerplate only.
judgments.reasoning_cat2: Identical to the other endorsement lead-ins; no friction.

judgments.reasoning_cat1: It amends 'the policy limits in Item 2' when limits appear in Item 3 (Item 2 is the policy period), and the consideration line is left blank ('additional premium of $ __').
judgments.reasoning_cat2: The Declarations state $18,000,000 each occurrence and $9,000,000 aggregate, so this endorsement's $20M/$20M cannot be reconciled with them or with the Aggregate Limits Endorsement (c084) except by construction.

judgments.reasoning_cat1: Attachment boilerplate only.
judgments.reasoning_cat2: No tension with anything else.

judgments.reasoning_cat1: A flat deletion of two named forms; the drafting is clear on its face.
judgments.reasoning_cat2: The deleted forms (c105 Trebled Damages 009-133 and 009-118 (10/92)) still appear in the Schedule of Endorsements and in the policy text, so the instrument as assembled contradicts the deletion.

judgments.reasoning_cat1: A one-line attachment of a replacement form; the sentence is unpunctuated but plain.
judgments.reasoning_cat2: The form actually attached is numbered '003-118 WI (02/96)' rather than 009-118 (2/96), a mismatch with this cross-reference and with the Schedule of Endorsements.

judgments.reasoning_cat1: Like its predecessor it is essentially a statutory quotation, with the amendment expressed only as conformity to the statute.
judgments.reasoning_cat2: It again amends a 'Hospital Professional Liability coverage part' not contained in this umbrella policy, and its form number does not match the number recited in Endorsement No. 5 (c112).

judgments.reasoning_cat1: Attachment boilerplate only.
judgments.reasoning_cat2: Consistent with the other endorsements.

judgments.reasoning_cat1: A simple addition of one entity; the form is mis-typed as '0098-052'.
judgments.reasoning_cat2: It adds to the Additional Named Insureds endorsement (c085), which is form 009-052, so the typo is the only friction.

judgments.reasoning_cat1: Boilerplate saying the endorsement is effective on the inception date 'unless otherwise stated herein'.
judgments.reasoning_cat2: The endorsement's own effective date box reads 01/01/1997, so the boilerplate and the schedule entry point to different effective dates for adding CMG - Brown Deer Campus.

judgments.reasoning_cat1: One entity added 'as a Named Insured'; concrete and short.
judgments.reasoning_cat2: Other endorsements add entities by amending Form 009-052 (c115, c120), so it is unclear whether this addition carries the same 'no automatic coverage for newly acquired entities' qualification in c085.

judgments.reasoning_cat1: Attachment boilerplate only.
judgments.reasoning_cat2: The endorsement is dated 11/03/1997, after the 03/01/1997 expiry of the policy period, yet is made effective at inception — a fit problem with the Declarations Item 2.

judgments.reasoning_cat1: It substitutes 'Children's Health System, Inc.' (singular) for the declared 'Children's Health Systems, Inc.', a one-letter change whose intent is clear but whose effect on identity is not spelled out.
judgments.reasoning_cat2: Item 1 of the Declarations and every other endorsement heading use the plural form, so the instrument names the insured two ways.

judgments.reasoning_cat1: Two campuses added to a named form; nothing to construe.
judgments.reasoning_cat2: It builds on the Additional Named Insureds endorsement (c085) consistently, subject to the same cross-suits problem (c059).

judgments.reasoning_cat1: 'Those individuals and/or entities to whom this coverage applies and that are not subject to the Wisconsin Patients Compensation Fund' is doubly conditional and leaves the covered class undefined.
judgments.reasoning_cat2: The endorsement is headed to policy HPP-1996-4104-00 (the underlying CGL policy) yet appears in this umbrella file, and Item 7 shows only a $1,000,000 combined single limit, so the $1M/$3M figure does not match the Schedule of Underlying Insurance.

judgments.reasoning_cat1: 'At its sole option may make an appropriate premium charge' is discretionary but plainly so.
judgments.reasoning_cat2: It duplicates the premium mechanic in the Contingent Excess endorsement (c103) without contradiction.
